observations: Photo 0 shows a single car headlight assembly wrapped in clear plastic film.
The headlight has a modern design with a horizontal slat pattern in the main lens area.
The housing appears to be made of black plastic with a chrome or silver trim around the lens.
The plastic wrap is torn and uneven, suggesting it may be new or recently unpacked.
No visible branding, model markings, or part numbers are readable on the headlight itself.
The background is a rough, dark surface, possibly concrete or asphalt.

risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially damaged or non-functional

risks.risk: The headlight may not fit the intended vehicle model or may be a generic aftermarket part.

risks.if_unproven: priced as generic or unknown fit

risks.risk: The plastic wrap may be old or reused, indicating the item is not new or has been handled improperly.

proof_requests: A close-up photo of the headlight without plastic wrap, showing the lens, housing, and internal components.
A photo showing any part number or VIN tag on the headlight.
A photo of the headlight installed on a vehicle, if available.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
